submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 2mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution (1.294 ns) among all environmentally compliant options. While Mixture-G1 showed better performance (0.9 ns), it violates the mandatory GWP100 ≤ 150 requirement. Among compliant mixtures, G2 significantly outperforms G3 at all gap sizes. The 2mm gap provides optimal performance for G2, with better time resolution than both 1mm (1.438 ns) and 3mm (1.547 ns) configurations.
